module: Manages every frame (onPreRender) the display and interaction of mission/activity markers in freeroam and career: selects the clusters of nearby markers (radius 100 m) via the gameplay_playmodeMarkers quadtree, displays them, updates their ground decals, and opens the activity acceptance window when the player is stopped (less than 1 km/h, with hysteresis up to 3 km/h) or on foot in a zone. Also handles clearing the guidance on arrival (less than 7 m), single-screen multiplayer mode (multiseat) and mission formatting for the UI. The old mission launch functions are deprecated.
notes: Deprecated: startMissionById, stopMissionById and changeUserSettings only log an error and a stack trace; use gameplay_missions_missionManager.
Inconsistency: M.restartCurrent, M.abandonCurrent and M.getClusterMarker are assigned to local variables that are never defined: these fields are nil.
Probable bug: formatMission reads "mission.missionType" while the variable is m (the global mission is nil in this file); if m.missionTypeLabel is nil, the evaluation causes an error.
Probable bug: formatDataForUi calls M.isStateWithPlaymodeMarkers, which is not defined in this module (it exists in gameplay_playmodeMarkers); the call would fail.
Threshold speeds: stop < 1/3.6 then > 3/3.6 m/s; cruising 20 to 30 km/h (in m/s, 20/3.6 and 30/3.6).

Markers are only shown if the camera is not in photo mode, the editor is not active and the showMissionMarkers setting (or career, tutorial, first drive) allows it, except for a cluster taken in focus (navigation).
Emits the hooks onActivityAcceptGatherData(elemData, activityData), onMissionAvailabilityChanged({missionCount}) and onReachedTargetPos.

dependencies.desc: gameplay_missions_missions, gameplay_missions_missionManager, freeroam_bigMapMode, gameplay_playmodeMarkers, freeroam_bigMapPoiProvider, ui_missionInfo.

restartCurrent.desc: Always nil: reference to an undefined local variable.

abandonCurrent.desc: Always nil: reference to an undefined local variable.

getClusterMarker.desc: Always nil: reference to an undefined local variable.

navigationPoiId.desc: ID of the POI the player is navigating to (set by onNavigateToMission); its cluster stays displayed.

reachedTargetPos.desc: Last target reached; reset to nil when the player moves more than 20 m away from it.

getCurrentInteractableElements.desc: Returns the list of currently interactive elements (those of the open acceptance window).

formatMission.desc: Builds a mission's data table for the UI (name, description, preview, settings, attributes, progress, unlocks, context buttons).

returns.desc: Mission information formatted for the interface.

formatDataForUi.desc: Formats the missions of the current interactive elements for the UI, sorted by gameplay_missions_unlocks.depthIdSort.

returns.desc: List of formatted missions, or nil.

startMissionById.desc: Deprecated: logs an error and a stack trace, starts nothing.

stopMissionById.desc: Deprecated: logs an error and a stack trace.

changeUserSettings.desc: Deprecated: logs an error and a stack trace.

setPreselectedMissionId.desc: Stores a preselected mission ID (the variable is not read anywhere in this file).

getGameContext.desc: Returns the mission screen data via gameplay_missions_missionScreen.getMissionScreenData().

onSelectDetailPromptClicked.desc: Called by the UI when the player chooses an entry of the acceptance window: closes the dialog, clears ActivityAcceptUpdate and executes the chosen entry's buttonFun.

idx.desc: Index of the entry (1-based) in promptData.

closeViewDetailPrompt.desc: If force is true, closes the acceptance window, sends onMissionAvailabilityChanged with missionCount = 0 to the UI and the extensions.

onSettingsChanged.desc: Settings change hook: re-reads the resolution (GFXDevice.getVideoMode) and the aspect ratio.

onPreRender.desc: Pre-render hook, every frame: if the game state has play mode markers, handles arrival at the target, guidance and calls the display of the current level's mission markers; otherwise clears gameplay_playmodeMarkers.

clearCache.desc: Forces the acceptance window to be re-evaluated on the next pass.

skipNextIconFading.desc: Enables a local flag skipIconFading reset to false at the end of the next frame (no read in this file).

showMissionMarkersToggled.desc: To be called when the marker display setting changes: clears the raw POIs (gameplay_rawPois.clear) and forces the big map POIs to be sent again.

setMarkersVisibleTemporary.desc: Temporarily shows or hides all markers (except the focused cluster).

setForceReevaluateOpenPrompt.desc: Forces the acceptance window to be re-evaluated on the next frame.

onAnyMissionChanged.desc: Hook: on any mission state change, forces the POIs to be sent again; at start (state == "started"), deselects the big map, removes the focuses and closes the acceptance window if open.

onNavigateToMission.desc: Hook: resets the marker focuses then stores the POI being navigated to.

onClientEndMission.desc: Level end hook: forgets the navigation POI.

onUIPlayStateChanged.desc: Hook: on entering play mode (enteredPlay true), forces the acceptance window to be re-evaluated.

enteredPlay.desc: true if the UI switches to play mode.
